Patches:
  - stub ga()
  - strip App Store / Play promo and social GUI buttons
  - inline LDR_LLL1_0.png as a data URL (createTextureAsync)
  - expose window.FluidConfig and window.FluidApply so settings can be saved
  - if WebGL is missing, set window.FluidNoGL and skip shaders (honest black-screen)
  - cap devicePixelRatio on phones; FluidFrame / FluidOnChange / FluidOnCapture hooks
  - FluidGUI exposed so Back can close the panel

GifOS inlines classic scripts. Upstream loads analytics.js and store badges.
Those are stripped. Quality and dye settings are saved privately. The live
swirl is not snapshotted. Invite is not wired in v1 — solo is the original toy.
